title: The Customer filter resets when another asset is opened
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's current owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the asset's earlier owner.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, now owned by customer A, that earlier belonged to customer C, with work order 1 for customer C (made first, while customer C owned it) and work order 2 for customer A (made later), both at the test location and billing their own customer.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 2, owned by customer A, with one work order at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
  2. Click the "Customer" filter chip.
  3. Tick customer C.
  4. Apply the filter.
  5. Open asset 2's Work Orders tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • 2 rows are listed.

Step 2:

  • The options show.

Step 3:

  • Customer C is ticked.

Step 4:

  • Only work order 1 is listed; work order 2 is not.

Step 5:

  • The "Customer" chip reads "Customer: All customers".
  • Asset 2's work order is listed.
